verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail offers in-app automation rules for mail handling and a Zapier integration plus a direct API for building custom workflows, which could support autonomous background automations. However, there is no evidence of AI-native features, webhooks, event triggers, or documentation specifically enabling agentic/autonomous automation setups (openapi/llms.txt probes all 404). missing for 10: documented API/webhook capabilities for autonomous triggers, evidence of AI-agent-oriented automation, independent confirmation of Zapier/API depth.
